sections.heading: Our Story
sections.text: Our Christmas light display combines a love of Christmas with a desire to make people smile. It all began in 2020 when our son, Thomas, was just eight years old and decided to decorate our home with a handful of lights. What started as a small display quickly grew into a family tradition that grows every year.

sections.heading: Why We Do This
sections.text: In 2023, we invited visitors to make charity donations and raised £251.44 for Mountbatten Isle of Wight, a charity that has supported our family and many others in times of need. In 2024, we raised £200.31 for RSPCA Isle of Wight, to thank them for caring for our kittens that were rescued from Lynbottom Household Waste Recycling Centre in 2022.

sections.heading: The Display
sections.text: Each year, we add to the display to make it bigger and better. This year, we have the addition of a snow machine which is proving to be a big hit! We look forward to welcoming visitors again this year and raising even more for charity — but above all, we just love making people smile!
